Force changed=true to measure copying. Full bytes including unused tails, source immutability, upload ranges and target versions checked before/after.
limits: Measures isolated copy calls, not visibility/culling/frame/GPU or production/FPS improvement.
No new retained run cache; subarray views are transient allocations. GC causality and motion spikes are unproven.
Threshold64components is a local engineering choice, not a universal optimum. fixtures.bulkSlots describes slots in runs>=4, not fast-path invocations.
Exact real inputs in four views and public/GPU regression fixtures, not exhaustive cloud image parity or arbitrary malformed attributes.
All earlier plain-context timings retained only as exploratory/rejected evidence; actual receiver-shape impact was not separately traced.
Audit16 remains open for other CPU work, dust/nebula GPU and movement spikes.

diagnosis.note: Exploratory only. Plain synthetic receivers differed from live class receiver shapes; their timing is not acceptance evidence.
